Research the Raptor DOS game (GPL C source in SOURCE/, GFX/, audiolib/, apodmx/) and its shareware data (data/*.GLB) to understand formats needed to port to HTML5.

Read-only research. Report exact formats, byte layouts, file struct offsets. Quote relevant code.

- TILE: RLE-encoded? width/height header?
- MAP: 2D array of tile indices? dimensions?

Compressed research report per file with exact byte offsets/struct layouts.
